nodes.name: API Design
nodes.summary: Complete inventory of 218 REST API endpoints across 17 modules (auth, CRM, catalog, equipment, quotations, rentals, billing, etc.) with request flow diagram, API conventions, response patterns, and 7 planned new endpoints for profitability and executive BI phases.

nodes.name: Backend Architecture
nodes.summary: Defines the FastAPI/Python layered architecture (routes→schemas→services→repositories→models), middleware stack, router registration order, cross-service dependencies, database engine configuration, lifecycle hooks, and backend refactor targets per phase.

nodes.name: Compatibility Report
nodes.summary: Analyzes backward compatibility across API URLs, database schema, frontend routes, state management, CSS classes, TypeScript types, permissions, Docker deployment, and third-party dependencies for all refactor phases, identifying one managed breaking change (brand pagination response shape).

nodes.name: Database Design
nodes.summary: Documents all 56 database tables across 11 domains (Auth, CRM, Catalog, Equipment, Quotation, Rental, Movement, Maintenance, Inventory, Billing, Executive BI) with column inventories, foreign key relationships, domain enumerations, index strategy, and the Alembic migration chain.

nodes.name: Deployment Design
nodes.summary: Specifies the Docker Compose deployment stack with three containers (Nginx frontend, Uvicorn FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL 16 database), Nginx configuration, environment variable requirements, database migration strategy, startup sequence, health monitoring, volume management gaps, and a proposed CI/CD pipeline.

nodes.name: Frontend Architecture
nodes.summary: Documents the React 19/TypeScript SPA architecture including 47 routes with lazy-loaded pages, four Zustand stores (auth, sidebar, theme, toast), 17 Axios API modules, CSS layer system with design tokens, TypeScript type files, component inventory by category, and cross-module CSS coupling problems to resolve.

nodes.name: Impact Analysis
nodes.summary: Provides per-phase change impact analysis covering file counts modified/created, breaking change identification, dependency ordering graph, risk matrix with probability/impact ratings, and notes that current test coverage is 0% with recommended tooling per layer.

nodes.name: Migration Plan
nodes.summary: Defines the week-by-week execution sequence for all 10 refactor phases and cross-cutting concerns, with concrete step-by-step instructions, commit message conventions, database Alembic migration commands, pre-migration checklist, and post-migration verification checks.

nodes.name: Module Design
nodes.summary: Per-module breakdown of current backend/frontend implementation state and specific refactor targets for all 11 CRM modules (Auth through Executive BI), cross-module dependency graph, and TypeScript interface specs for new shared components SearchSelect and Can.

nodes.name: Rollback Plan
nodes.summary: Defines three-tier rollback strategy (surgical single-phase revert, cascade multi-phase revert, full nuclear rollback to pre-refactor git tag) with per-phase revert impact details, Alembic downgrade commands, SQLite and PostgreSQL backup restore procedures, a symptom-based decision matrix, and recovery time objectives.

nodes.name: Security Design
nodes.summary: Covers JWT token architecture (HS256, 30-min access + 7-day refresh with JTI revocation), RBAC with 28 permissions across 4 roles, CORS configuration, security header middleware, file upload controls (MIME/extension whitelist, UUID filenames), database security via ORM parameterization, frontend token storage tradeoffs, and 10 identified security gaps with priorities.
